ABOUT THE ATLAS

One family trip, mapped day by day.

1 · A Luzern base

David and Michelle traveled with her parents, returning to Luzern on most days and staying in Como for the Italian portion.

2 · Every leg matters

Train, boat, bus, gondola, walking, and bicycle legs are mapped in their actual order. Open any day to isolate its route.

3 · Rail stops included

Day close-ups mark the scheduled rail stops along each representative route, with selected travel lines brought to the front.

4 · Photos follow the day

The full-screen viewer keeps each day's photographs together. Day controls move the route map and journal context with the images.

Privacy: the public site asks search engines not to index or archive it, but anyone with the URL can still open it.
